notes.title: controller support, bug fixes and balance adjustments
notes.notes: [p]Dear Readers,[/p][p align="start"]This update introduces comprehensive controller support, enhances the gameplay experience, and includes multiple bug fixes and balance adjustments[/p][p]. Below are the detailed update notes:[/p][p][/p][h1]🎮 Controller Support System[/h1][p align="start"]​[b]Core Controls:​[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]Use controller joystick to aim[/p][/*][*][p]Mouse movement prioritizes aim position[/p][/*][*][p]A Button: Activate all equipped attack spells[/p][/*][*][p]X Button: Use all equipped shield spells[/p][/*][*][p]B Button: Trigger all equipped ultimate spells[/p][/*][*][p]Y Button (after selecting spell slot): Toggle auto-cast mode[/p][/*][*][p]START Button: Open ESC menu[/p][/*][*][p]B Button: Close some pop-up UIs[/p][/*][*][p]LT Button: Quickly snap aim back to self for easier targeting[/p][/*][*][p]RT Button: 2x aim movement speed[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]​[b]System Optimizations:​[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]All UIs fully support controller navigation for smooth operation[/p][/*][*][p]Sliders automatically adapt to controller-selected UI element position for better display[/p][/*][*][p]New player tutorial adds controller button explanations and fully adapts to controller operation[/p][/*][/list][h2][i][u]​[b]Important Notes:​[/b][/u][/i]​[/h2][list][*][p]Controller support must be manually enabled: Check the 【Enable Controller Support】 option in the 【Options】 menu[/p][/*][*][p]Default state is 【Disabled】[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed tutorial interface misalignment issues on some resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ink icon display misalignment on certain resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weather switching chaos when clicking weather icons in the Infuse Star panel[/p][/*][/list][h1]⚖️ Balance Adjustments[/h1][list][*][p]Nerfed 【Flame Thrower】 spell power to better match its level[/p][/*][*][p]Books now require clearing 【Apocalypse 10】 difficulty to earn the special green frame and visual effects for highest difficulty completion[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: inflation mechanism adjustments, bug fixes, and balance tweaks
notes.notes: [h1]⚡ Performance Optimizations[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed instant lag caused by mass buff application/removal[/p][/*][/list][h1]💰 Inflation Adjustments[/h1][list][*][p]Redesigned shop pricing formula[/p][/*][*][p]Now calculates based on current crystal count (instead of historical maximum)[/p][/*][*][p]Price scaling based on crystal holdings:[/p][list][*][p]<2000: No inflation[/p][/*][*][p]2000-20k: Slight price increase[/p][/*][*][p]20k-1M: Moderate price increase[/p][/*][*][p]1M-10M: Drastic price inflation[/p][/*][*][p]10M: Cannot purchase more items with more crystal (for those extreme players!)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed duplicate faction burning options[/p][/*][*][p]Burned factions no longer appear in selection[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed opposing factions still being burnable under Focus Magic[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected English localization for 【Grandfather Paradox】[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 【Quantum Mechanics】 incorrectly targeting 【Crystal Shards】 in auto-aim mode[/p][/*][/list][h1]⚖️ Balance Changes[/h1][list][*][p]Faction burning options increased from 2 to 3 choices[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial mode now provides base HP regen to reduce new player deaths[/p][/*][*][p]【Quantum Mechanics】+auto-aim now calculates nearest enemy from clone position (not main body)[/p][/*][/list][h1]🌌 Endless Mode Adjustments[/h1][list][*][p]Purchasing passive spells slightly reduces their shop refresh chance (resets at next stage)[/p][/*][*][p]Passive fragment stage rewards unaffected[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Thank you for your continued support! We'll keep working to bring you a better gaming experience.[/p]

notes.title: ✨v1.0.3.6 Update Announcement
notes.notes: [h1]✨ New Features[/h1][p align="start"]【Low Power Mode】[/p][list][*][p]Added 【Low Power Mode】 toggle in 【Options Panel】[/p][/*][*][p]Limits visual effects and makes bullet images Acquisition】[/p][list][*][p]【Shop】 and 【Chapter】 rewards no longer offer 【Non-Current Weather】magics, helping players build synergies faster[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]【Summon System】[/p][list][*][p]When summon limit is reached, extends duration AND adds bonus damage to all existing summons of same type[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]【Starting Book Balance】[/p][list][*][p]【Shooting Art】 +10 mana regen, +10 stability[/p][/*][*][p]【Magic Encyclopedia】 +5 HP regen, +5 attack speed & crit[/p][/*][*][p]【Ballistics】 +50 crit, +50 crit damage, retains shield crit, no longer -150 attack speed[/p][/*][*][p]【Art is Explosion】 no longer reduces HP/MP caps or base attack[/p][/*][*][p]【Postpartum Pig Care】 +25 base HP, sow growth crystal reward increased to 2[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]【Other Adjustments】[/p][list][*][p]Rebalanced matching magic appearance rates for Judgement difficulties 1-4[/p][/*][*][p]Added prominent visual effects for combo notes.title: v1.0.3.5 Weekly Update Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Dear Players,[/p][p align="start"]We are delighted to bring you the v1.2.0 update for Book Shooter! This update introduces an auto-aiming feature, optimizes game performance, fixes multiple bugs, and includes balance adjustments. Below are the detailed update notes:[/p][p][/p][p]✨ New Features[/p][p align="start"]【Auto-Aiming System】[/p][list][*][p]Added auto-aim toggle in the 【Options Panel】[/p][/*][*][p]When enabled, mouse hovering over your spellbook in combat will automatically target the nearest enemy[/p][/*][*][p]Does not work with special spellbooks (e.g., Burning Steel, Engineering)[/p][/*][*][p]Will attempt to fire all equipped shoot spells even if auto-cast is disabled[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]⚡ Performance Optimizations[/p][list][*][p]Improved performance when opening 【Magic Book】 panel with too many spells[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed performance issues caused by excessive 【Black Hole】 stacking[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced computation interval for high-frequency effects, improving overall smoothness[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized lightning strike visual effects:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced particle count[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered visual intensity when disappearing[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved snowman and magic crystal generation/conversion logic, significantly reducing lag[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]🐞 Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed potential errors during character refresh[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized logging system to exclude irrelevant information, improving performance[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified font animation implementation and fixed related errors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed potential errors when returning to main menu after defeating a Boss[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemies getting stuck at screen edges making them unbeatable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed temporary collision detection failure for enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 【Space Circle】 enemy gathering effect being affected by player range[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed specific units (Sow, Turrets) still triggering hover effects at max level[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display issues with certain turret summons[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]⚖️ Balance Adjustments[/p][p align="start"]【Engineering】[/p][list][*][p]Maximum deployed turrets reduced to 30[/p][/*][*][p]Gain +1 turret capacity every 7 levels[/p][/*][*][p]Exceeding capacity now triggers 3 waves of force barrage and grants +3 permanent EXP[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]【Visual Effects】[/p][list][*][p]【Shining Angel】 and 【Anti-Magic Demon】 no longer cause screen darkening[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]【Magic System】[/p][list][*][p]【Spell Research】 purchases no longer reduce random player properties (slightly lowered bonuses instead)[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced 【Passive】 spell refresh rate, increased 【Spell Research】 refresh rate[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]【Stage Rewards】[/p][list][*][p]Adding rare properties in bonus stages no longer increases enemy HP[/p][/*][*][p]【Small Chest】 and 【Rare Chest】 rewards now scale with player level[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]【Endless Mode】[/p][list][*][p]Significantly reduced enemy attack power growth rate[/p][/*][*][p]Still has chance to spawn white and blue magics in shop[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]【UI Improvements】[/p][list][*][p]Reduced waiting time for score display and confirm button in stage completion screen[/p][/*][*][p]Increased auto-cast tooltip text size on skill icons[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Thank you for your continued support! We'll keep working to bring you a better gaming experience.[/p]

notes.title: Performance Optimization & Balance Update
notes.notes:
[p]Dear readers, to provide a smoother gaming experience and more balanced gameplay, we've conducted comprehensive performance optimizations and numerical adjustments. Here are the details of this update:[/p][p][/p][h3]Performance Optimization[/h3][p]​[b]​+ Projectile System Optimization[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]Removed physics interactions between bullets, essentially eliminating lag caused by \[excessive bullets, oversized volumes, scatter/salvo/rapid fire][/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted particle counts for certain visual effects to reduce performance overhead[/p][/*][*][p]Removed some glaring visual effects to improve visual comfort[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]​[b]​+ Summon Limits[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]\[Skeleton Archers] now have a maximum limit - exceeding this limit will instead increase duration of all existing skeleton archers[/p][/*][*][p]\[Little Devil] and other common summons will also have quantity limits to prevent late-game lag[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p]​[b]​+ Bullet System Fixes[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where oversized bullets could cause colliders to go outside map boundaries[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bullet detachment issue caused by excessive attack speed[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Numerical Adjustments[/h3][p]​[b]​+ Economy Rebalance[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]Readjusted game economy curve to prevent players from easily emptying shops in late-game[/p][/*][*][p]\[Postpartum Pig Care] reduced crystal yield from growth states[/p][/*][*][p]\[Crystal Extraction] magic no longer works on magic crystals to prevent infinite crystal exploits[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]​[b]​+ Attribute Balancing[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]\[Recharge], \[Frequency], \[Memory], \[Fortune], \[Discount], \[Pjt Spd] properties now use smoother value curves[/p][/*][*][p]\[Lucky Title Page] appropriately nerfed[/p][/*][*][p]\[Attack Speed] property cap set at 300 - excess values will be converted to equivalent attack power[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]​[b]​+ Spell Adjustments[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]\[Sands of Time] nerfed to 0.02s per rock kill[/p][/*][*][p]\[Snowburst Crystal] adjusted to produce 1 magic crystal with reduced cooldown[/p][/*][*][p]\[Creation Bullet] now grants 3 crystals per hit but capped at 300 per battle[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]​[b]​+ Other Changes[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]Experience thresholds will now continue increasing beyond level 20[/p][/*][*][p]\[Betrayal of the Silver Hand] mythic effect reduced to 0.01s per shot[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Major Demo Update
notes.notes:
Update Notes​
✓ Added Traditional Chinese language support
✓ Added English language support
✓ New "Add to Wishlist" button (Pretty please? qwq)

✓ Optimized performance when browsing encyclopedia with many entries
✓ New completion panel showing unlocked characters on main menu after finishing a run

• Changed "-50 Attack" to "+35 Enemy Max HP"
• Library rewards can now be refreshed 3 times

​Bug Fixes​
• Fixed multi-hit triggering incorrectly with delayed fireballs
• Fixed magic slot acquisition not updating UI in combat
• Fixed fast-moving units potentially getting stuck at screen edges

​​[NEW] Library System​
— Spend Ink to draw [Masterpieces], [Epics], and [Mythics]
— Each tier provides unique bonuses, with [Mythics] granting mechanical upgrades
— Chance to draw [Trash] instead
— [Trash] applies various debuffs (visual, targeting, and stat penalties)
— Library get cleared by the janitor daily at midnight :-(

​​[NEW] Quality of Life​
• Right-click skill icons to toggle Auto-Cast mode
• At Level 11, you may join a Subclass (effects capped at 5 levels)

Happy gaming, everyone!

notes.title: Another buttery-smooth update fixes
notes.notes:
+道具灌注星星时，对比提升的部分用金色文字下划线标注出
+雷鸣天气下闪电打击造成的伤害受到玩家属性增幅
+加强演员书，现在每3级就获得1个魔法槽（原来是每5级）
+重新调整经验值曲线，现在最终关时的等级比原来提升了3级左右
+提升所有最终boss的难度，以符合现在玩家的成长曲线
+额外增加了魔方boss的难度
+修复了打魔方boss后，重新开档导致拖拽技能图标位置错误
+提升攻击魔法刷出的权重，现在商店中更容易出现攻击魔法了
+魔法百科书增强，虽然没有特别能力但是现在成了数值怪
+修复了购买增加属性的道具后，部分属性条目数字没有更新的问题
+修复了攻击护盾史莱姆会弹出完美格挡字样的问题
+略微降低了动态难度的数值，以匹配新的玩家成长曲线

Happy gaming, everyone!

notes.title: Buttery-smooth update fixes
notes.notes:
+不常见的关卡后奖励节点增加了详细的效果描述
+增加玩家受伤时的屏幕闪红反馈
+调整了第六关首领的数值符合难度
+修正了【二元硬币】的关卡描述多了一个中括号的问题
+修正了战斗内改变天气后，左上角的天气图标没有实时改变的问题
+修正了开档时出现上个周目锁住道具的问题
+调整【攻击】属性，现在不仅提供百分比加成，还能在每20点提供1固定伤害加成（基础伤害为1的攻击魔法现在站起来啦！）
+增加更多大波敌人来袭
+护盾格挡时，如果完全抵挡伤害，则会弹出【完美格挡】文字
+完美格挡时屏幕会有闪白反馈
+现在最终boss战斗也会出现死神收割，不能再无限拖延时间啦
+胜利评估中去掉命中率，改为击杀率，放宽评级标准
+【奥术学校】学院的lv10效果改为：每当大波敌人和首领出现时，刷新所有魔法cd
+创建角色面板中返回主菜单时，再次创建角色会保留已经作出的选择而不是清空重选
+环绕光子魔法加强
+射击时书本的blingbling动画不会停止

Happy gaming, everyone!
